about: Rig E's classes checked by hand on a fixed sample: the first fifteen model-judged sites of each class by the digest of their keys (`audit.mts sample --per-class 15`), each read in full and labelled with the class a careful reader gives it. Contested sites are labelled too, and never agree, since contested is not a class a reader gives.
reader: the agent that built the rig
